title: Transport of the native Hom cone boundary along a coefficient isomorphism
statement: For a K-injective complex I, an isomorphism Q(I)≅M, and a cochain map f:E→G, naturality of the evaluation comparison and signed source mate gives an isomorphism between the prescribed native Hom cone triangle for Q(I) and the one for M.

proof.text: Apply naturality of internal Hom in the coefficient and of the mate defining siteHomSignedSourceComponent to the coefficient isomorphism; the three resulting squares assemble into a Triangle iso.

proof_origin.note: Strict transport reduction separating coefficient naturality from the model cone calculation.

mathlib_searches.query: internalHom mapIso naturality signed source mate
mathlib_searches.results: No exact triangle transport theorem with the prescribed mate; categorical Triangle.isoMk supplies the assembly.

from.place: Coefficient transport portion of the proof.

lean.statement:
theorem nativeHom_localized_cone_boundary_transport
    {C : Type d} [Category.{u + 1} C] [Abelian C]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} C] [MonoidalCategory C]
    [MonoidalPreadditive C] [MonoidalClosed C] [BraidedCategory C]
    [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution C]
    {E G : CochainComplex C ℤ} (f : E ⟶ G)
    (I : CochainComplex C ℤ) [I.IsKInjective]
    (M : DerivedCategory C) (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj I ≅ M) :
    let M₀ := DerivedCategory.Q.obj I
    let H₀ := MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj M₀
    let H := MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj M
    let T := (triangleOpEquivalence (DerivedCategory C)).functor.obj
      (op (DerivedCategory.Q.mapTriangle.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone.triangle f)))
    Nonempty (Triangle.mk (H₀.map T.mor₁) (H₀.map T.mor₂)
      (H₀.map T.mor₃ ≫ siteHomSignedSourceComponent M₀ 1 T.obj₁) ≅
      Triangle.mk (H.map T.mor₁) (H.map T.mor₂)
        (H.map T.mor₃ ≫ siteHomSignedSourceComponent M 1 T.obj₁))
